messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick pragmatic manager week-1 playbook + decision-rights checklist. Paste into your hire folder. Short, prioritized, and focused on removing blockers and clarifying authority. :seedling:

Noor (new manager): This looks great — can we include a simple escalation path? Also need analytics access asap.

Liam (Hiring Manager): Escalation path: Day 1 for blockers -> hiring manager; Day 2+ -> #help-it or relevant owner; urgent security issues -> @SIA. For analytics/billing, mark the Access Portal request as 'urgent' and tag me.

Maya (People Ops): Week-1 plan (recommended slots):
- Pre-day: confirm laptop + peripherals, add recurring 1:1 + 30/60/90 placeholder, drop welcome blurb to team.
- Day 1 AM: 30m team intro (people + 3 things team is shipping), 20m role & expectations w/ hiring manager.
- Day 1 PM: IT handoff (SSO/Okta, Slack, email, VPN), request analytics & billing read access.
- Day 2: Repo access, CI basics, security attestation (SIA quick check).
- Day 3: Identify a small visible first deliverable (README, dashboard note, flaky test fix).
- By EOW: Draft 30/60/90 with measurable signals and share for feedback.

Noor (new manager): For the 30/60/90 I want a template that maps to outcomes + measures, not just tasks. Anyone have a short example?

Maya (People Ops): Use this framing: Objective (what success looks like), Key Result(s) (measurable signals), First deliverables (3 small actions), Stakeholders (who you will rely on), Decision rights (what you can sign off on). Example snippet you can copy: 
- Objective: Improve onboarding velocity for new hires in the team.
- KRs: reduce time-to-first-PR from 10d -> 5d; get 3 onboarding README PRs merged.
- First deliverables: update team README, add onboarding checklist to repo, ship one small infra tweak.
- Decision rights: can approve README edits and low-risk infra tweaks; must escalate infra config changes that touch prod to Platform lead.

Diego (IT): @Noor DM your corp email and I'll pre-provision analytics read + billing read after Liam approves the Access Portal request. Quick SSH steps if you need repo pushes:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "noor@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Paste pub key into Access Portal -> Tech Access. Include which repos you need in the request.

SIA (Security): Note: sign data handling attestation before pulling any production datasets. If you need a sandbox dataset for week 1, request via #dataops.

Noor (new manager): Sent DM with email + key, and filed Access Portal request. Also planning weekly 1:1s + 30-day skip-level.

Maya (People Ops): Recommended norms to set in week 1: 1) Decision breakpoints (what you can approve vs escalate), 2) Communication expectations (response windows, meeting cadence), 3) Feedback loops (monthly async pulse + biweekly retro). Share with your team in your first week intro.

Liam (Hiring Manager): Approved analytics request. If anything stalls, tag me in the Access Portal request and drop a line here.

onboard-bot: Reminder: complete payroll & tax forms within 48h.
